answer_as_filed: Neighborhood Health Association  does not separately account for or segregate 340B savings from other sources of operating revenue. Rather, 340B savings, together with revenue generated from medical and other patient care services, are reinvested to support the organization's mission of providing comprehensive healthcare to underserved and vulnerable populations.
We do not bill for clinic administered meds

These funds help support patient care programs and operations, including pharmacy services, care coordination, medication access and adherence initiatives, chronic disease management programs, clinical staffing, and other services that improve access to quality healthcare for uninsured and underinsured patients. For example, care coordination programs help patients navigate the healthcare system, connect with needed services, improve medication adherence, and reduce barriers to receiving ongoing care.
